other_conditions: Applicant should be interested in goat rearing
Applicant should be a widow, abandoned, destitute, living alone, or disaster‑affected woman
Selection of beneficiaries is on a first‑come first‑served basis
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹35,000 for purchase of one goat unit (3 females and 1 male) aged 12‑18 months.
